claims: C1 the assistant should seek clarification when an instruction might be intended
C2 the duty to seek clarification applies when following the instruction could cause serious side effects
C3 the duty is triggered by the conjunction of possible intent and serious side effects

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: rules in the #ignore_untrusted_data section carry root authority
concepts.inference: the graph's NEEDS block states this, and another node establishes it

concepts.name: might_be_intended_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that might be intended, even if not explicitly stated

concepts.name: serious_side_effects
concepts.gloss: following instruction I could cause serious side effects in context C

concepts.name: clarification_context
concepts.gloss: C is the context in which clarification is sought about instruction I
concepts.inference: the duty to seek clarification must be about a particular instruction and a particular context

asserts.read_back: the assistant should seek clarification about instruction % in context % because the instruction might be intended and could cause serious side effects

closure.reason: the clause obliges seeking clarification only when an instruction might be intended and could cause serious side effects; it does not forbid seeking clarification in other situations, so silence permits it
